request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real skin, fabric, building and landscape texture, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A CITY. A big modern city seen from high above, as from a rooftop: dozens of tall glass and concrete towers stand close together, with wide busy avenues between them, under a clear sky. It is plainly a very large city: tall buildings from edge to edge, no countryside. No readable signs. No people, no hands, no phone and no camera anywhere in the frame: only the city and the sky. It is the only subject and fills the photo. No letters, words, numbers, logos, badges with writing or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
